import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 8.23

by L. G. Kovács

If the dihedral group $D$ of order 18 is a section of a direct product $A \times B$,
must at least one of $A$ and $B$ have a section isomorphic to $D$?

Here a *section* of a group $G$ is a quotient of a subgroup of $G$, i.e. a homomorphic
image of a subgroup of $G$. The dihedral group of order 18 is `DihedralGroup 9`.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«8.23»

/-- A group $S$ is a *section* of a group $G$ if $S$ is a homomorphic image of a subgroup
of $G$, i.e. $S \cong H / N$ for some subgroup $H \le G$ and some normal subgroup
$N \trianglelefteq H$. -/
def IsSection (S : Type*) [Group S] (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : Subgroup G) (f : H →* S), Function.Surjective f

/-- A group $S$ is a section of $G$ if and only if $S$ is isomorphic to a quotient $H / N$
of a subgroup $H \le G$ by a normal subgroup $N \trianglelefteq H$. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem isSection_iff {S G : Type*} [Group S] [Group G] :
    IsSection S G ↔
      ∃ (H : Subgroup G) (N : Subgroup H) (_ : N.Normal), Nonempty (H ⧸ N ≃* S) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨H, f, hf⟩
    exact ⟨H, f.ker, inferInstance, ⟨QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective f hf⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨H, N, hN, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact ⟨H, e.toMonoidHom.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' N),
      e.surjective.comp QuotientGroup.mk_surjective⟩

/-- Every group is a section of itself. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem isSection_self (G : Type*) [Group G] : IsSection G G :=
  ⟨⊤, Subgroup.topEquiv.toMonoidHom, fun g => ⟨⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Every subgroup of a group is a section of it. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem isSection_subgroup {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) : IsSection H G :=
  ⟨H, MonoidHom.id H, Function.surjective_id⟩

/-- Every quotient of a group by a normal subgroup is a section of it. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem isSection_quotient {G : Type*} [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    IsSection (G ⧸ N) G :=
  ⟨⊤, (QuotientGroup.mk' N).comp Subgroup.topEquiv.toMonoidHom,
    QuotientGroup.mk_surjective.comp fun g => ⟨⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩, rfl⟩⟩

/-- `DihedralGroup 9` is the dihedral group of order 18. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem nat_card_dihedralGroup_nine : Nat.card (DihedralGroup 9) = 18 :=
  DihedralGroup.nat_card

/--
If the dihedral group $D$ of order 18 is a section of a direct product $A \times B$,
must at least one of $A$ and $B$ have a section isomorphic to $D$?

The groups $A$ and $B$ are arbitrary (not assumed finite), as in the source.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«8.23» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (A B : Type) [Group A] [Group B],
      IsSection (DihedralGroup 9) (A × B) →
        IsSection (DihedralGroup 9) A ∨ IsSection (DihedralGroup 9) B := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«8.23»

# Conjecture 8.23

by L. G. Kovács

If the dihedral group $D$ of order 18 is a section of a direct product $A \times B$,
must at least one of $A$ and $B$ have a section isomorphic to $D$?

Here a *section* of a group $G$ is a quotient of a subgroup of $G$. The dihedral group
of order 18 is `DihedralGroup 9`. The statement places no finiteness assumption on
$A$ and $B$.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«8.23»

/-- A group `S` is a *section* of a group `G` if `S` is isomorphic to a quotient of a
subgroup of `G`; equivalently, there is a subgroup `H` of `G` and a surjective group
homomorphism `H →* S`. -/
def IsSectionOf (S G : Type*) [Group S] [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : Subgroup G) (f : H →* S), Function.Surjective f

/-- Every group is a section of itself. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem isSectionOf_self (G : Type*) [Group G] : IsSectionOf G G :=
  ⟨⊤, (⊤ : Subgroup G).subtype, fun g => ⟨⟨g, trivial⟩, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Each factor of a direct product is a section of the product. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem isSectionOf_prod_left (A B : Type*) [Group A] [Group B] : IsSectionOf A (A × B) :=
  ⟨⊤, (MonoidHom.fst A B).comp (⊤ : Subgroup (A × B)).subtype,
    fun a => ⟨⟨(a, 1), trivial⟩, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Each factor of a direct product is a section of the product. -/
@[category API, AMS 20]
theorem isSectionOf_prod_right (A B : Type*) [Group A] [Group B] : IsSectionOf B (A × B) :=
  ⟨⊤, (MonoidHom.snd A B).comp (⊤ : Subgroup (A × B)).subtype,
    fun b => ⟨⟨(1, b), trivial⟩, rfl⟩⟩

/--
If the dihedral group $D$ of order 18 is a section of a direct product $A \times B$,
must at least one of $A$ and $B$ have a section isomorphic to $D$?

Here $D$ is `DihedralGroup 9` (of order $2 \cdot 9 = 18$), and a section of a group is a
quotient of one of its subgroups. The groups $A$ and $B$ are arbitrary (not assumed finite).
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«8.23» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (A B : Type) [Group A] [Group B],
      IsSectionOf (DihedralGroup 9) (A × B) →
        IsSectionOf (DihedralGroup 9) A ∨ IsSectionOf (DihedralGroup 9) B := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«8.23»
